jobs.title: Corporate Development & Strategy - Vice President
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
iCapital is seeking an experienced and dynamic Vice President to join the Corporate Development and Strategy team. This role will be instrumental in driving iCapital’s long-term growth across the wealth and alternatives ecosystem by leading the evaluation, planning, and execution of both organic and inorganic strategic initiatives. Working directly with Senior Leadership, this individual will help support the development and execution of the company’s strategic priorities by driving cross‑functional alignment, accountability, and momentum to ensure successful implementation of key initiatives.

Responsibilities

- Conduct in-depth strategic research, synthesize findings, and present actionable recommendations on new business opportunities to senior leadership.

- Lead rigorous, data-driven analysis (both quantitative and qualitative) to inform and shape Corporate Development and Strategy recommendations.

- Incorporate approved AI and automation tools thoughtfully into day‑to‑day workflows to improve the speed, quality, and scalability of strategic analysis, diligence, and execution.

- Identify, evaluate, and support strategic opportunities proactively, including partnerships, minority investments, and selective acquisitions aligned with the company’s long-term goals.

- Run point on key aspects of the due diligence process for select strategic transactions, managing multiple workstreams to ensure thorough analysis and informed decision-making.

- Work closely with external counterparties and internal stakeholders to advance strategic opportunities from initial evaluation through transaction or partnership execution.

- Serve as a trusted resource for external market research, competitive intelligence, industry trends, and potential partnership or acquisition opportunities across the organization.

- Curate and distribute relevant industry insights, enabling teams across the organization to make data-driven decisions.

- Prepare executive-level presentations, business plans, financial analyses, and industry reports, clearly communicating complex findings both verbally and in writing.

- Partner with internal stakeholders to support the development and drive execution of strategic initiatives, ensuring alignment and measurable outcomes.

- Lead special projects for senior leadership in support of iCapital’s broader strategic objectives.

Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in corporate development or strategy, investing (PE and VC), investment banking, or in a similar strategic role

- Experience in an entrepreneurial, performance-driven environment, financial technology or financial services background is strongly preferred

- Demonstrated experience evaluating and supporting M&A transactions, partnerships, and strategic negotiations

- Strong interest in alternative investments, wealth management, and building an industry-defining company

- Able to thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment with competing priorities and tight deadlines

- Highly self-motivated with a strong work ethic and ownership mindset

- Quick learner, adaptable to new industries, business models, and shifting priorities

- Strong understanding of KPIs and their role in strategic decision-making

- Clear and effective communicator with the ability to create impactful, executive-ready presentations and recommendations with proficiency in PowerPoint

- Highly organized, team-oriented collaborator with experience managing multiple complex projects and working with external partners (i.e. investment bankers, legal teams, consultants)

- Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across levels of the organization

- Experience with alternative funds, including familiarity with fund structures, operations, and valuation methodologies, is a plus

Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $200,000 to $250,000.  iCapital offers a compensation package which includes salary, equity for all full-time employees, and an annual performance bonus. Employees also receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes an employer matched retirement plan, generously subsidized healthcare with 100% employer paid dental, vision, telemedicine, and virtual mental health counseling, parental leave, and unlimited paid time off (PTO).

We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office Monday-Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Friday.

jobs.title: Corporate Finance, FP&A - Associate
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
About the Role

iCapital is looking to hire a Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) Associate to join the Corporate Finance team. This role will involve large-scale responsibilities across financial and managerial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, analysis of key financial and performance indicators, monthly and quarterly management and board reporting duties (including support during the financial close), financial modelling, along with partnership across key business and department leads to enhance decision making. The FP&A Associate will report into Firmwide FP&A,Vice President.

Responsibilities

- Support the budgeting and forecasting of the firm’s consolidated key financial performance indicators, with emphasis on revenue, volume activity, and select GAAP and Non-GAAP metrics, liaising with line of business FP&A teams, sales and business leads, while providing analysis of budget vs. actuals and real-time forecasting.

- Assist in preparation of the company’s annual budget process across key financial performance indicators, volume-based inputs and activity and client level detail, while evaluating overall firmwide performance targets.

- Develop key financial and performance metrics dashboards with detailed analytics for the Management Committee, Board of Directors, and Business Leads.

- Identify and assess key opportunities to enhance the current reporting structure and develop new approaches to evaluate business performance.

- Partner with line of business FP&A teams and sales to develop monthly analysis and insights into variances between budget vs. actual results, client analytics and forecasts

- Perform sales analytics to support the business development and growth of the firm globally.

- Support the end-to-end preparation of monthly management and quarterly board reporting packages, including consolidation of financial statements, budget vs. actual results and revised forecasts, variance analysis and compilation of the company KPI reports.

- Identify and remediate process gaps and implement effective internal controls; improve documentation of internal control processes.

- Assist in completing special projects as needed, such as implementation of new software, platform reporting automation, and financial planning and analysis tools.

Qualifications

- 2-5 years of FP&A, corporate finance, management consulting or accounting experience within the financial services industry and/or FP&A experience with a top-tier firm.

- Familiarity with Private Market Investments such as Private Equity, Hedge Funds, Structured Investments is preferred, but not required

- Preference for candidates with experience in planning and ERP tools such as Workday Adaptive Planning, Anaplan, Tableau, etc. Oracle NetSuite and/or General Ledger systems such as SAP, PeopleSoft, Axiom preferred but not required.

- Able to work with business, sales and department leads on business performance including budgeting, forecasting and advanced analysis

- Advanced degree and/or credentials desired, such as MBA, CPA, CFA

- Advanced skills in Excel and PowerPoint

- Strong organizational, planning, quantitative modeling, and problem-solving skills; strategic and creative thinking

- Able to manage large sets of data and implement checks and balances

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills

- Detailed oriented with big picture capability

Employees also receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes an employer matched retirement plan, generously subsidized healthcare with 100% employer paid dental, vision, telemedicine, and virtual mental health counseling, parental leave, and unlimited paid time off (PTO).

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager - Associate
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Marketing Operations Associate to join iCapital's International Marketing & Communications team in Lisbon. The role reports jointly to the CMO International and to the VP, Marketing Operations & Asset Manager Partnerships, who provides day-to-day direction, guidance and prioritization.

This is a supporting role designed to build the operational backbone of the team. The successful candidate will assist with budget tracking, vendor administration, reporting and project coordination, and will provide execution support on strategic initiatives, management presentations and select deliverables across the wider International Marketing & Communications team.

Operating mode : The role sits at the intersection of operations, finance coordination and marketing execution, working under the direction of the Marketing Operations &Asset Management Partnerships lead and alongside regional marketing, communications and events colleagues. Based in Lisbon, the role collaborates daily with Zurich, London, Hong Kong and the wider international network, with occasional travel.

Key Responsibilities

Budget Tracking & Vendor Administration

- Assist in maintaining and tracking the International Marketing & Communications budget, monitoring spend by region, program and event against forecast.

- Support forecasting, accruals and reconciliation in partnership with Finance, flagging variances for review.

- Handle vendor and agency administration: onboarding paperwork, purchase orders, invoicing and payment tracking.

- Act as a day-to-day administrative contact for suppliers and agencies to keeping deliverables and costs on track.

Reporting & Management Presentations

- Support the annual planning process, KPI tracking and performance reporting, gathering and consolidating inputs from regional and functional teams.

- Help prepare updates and presentation materials for senior management, monthly alignment calls with client-facing teams and business reviews.

- Maintain dashboards and trackers that give visibility on priorities, milestones and deadlines.

Project Coordination & Process Support

- Support the coordination of cross-regional workstreams, maintaining timelines, action logs and follow-ups.

- Help ensure consistency of process and documentation across markets.

- Contribute ideas and support the implementation of improvements to templates, tools and ways of working.

- Maintain central repositories, naming conventions and workflow documentation for the international team.

Execution Support

- Provide hands-on support to strategic initiatives led by the CMO International and the Marketing Operations & Asset Manager Partnerships lead.

- Assist the wider International Marketing & Communications team on select deliverables across events, content initiatives and campaigns.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Support coordination between International Marketing & Communications, Events, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Compliance, and regional stakeholders.

- Help ensure global processes are applied consistently across regions.

Qualifications & Experience

- 2–5 years of experience in marketing operations, business operations, events or a comparable coordination or administrative role; financial services or professional services exposure an advantage.

- Comfort working with numbers, budgets and invoices, with strong attention to detail.

- Excellent organizational skills; able to manage multiple tasks and deadlines with guidance.

- Strong PowerPoint and Excel skills; able to produce clear, well-structured materials and trackers.

- CRM and or project management tool experience preferred ( such as monday.com )

- Strong written and verbal communication in English; additional languages an advantage.

- Collaborative, proactive and dependable, with a willingness to learn and the ability to work effectively across regions and time zones.

Why This Role Matters

As the International team continues to expand its event portfolio, content initiatives and business support responsibilities, dedicated operational support is essential to create a scalable infrastructure. This role improves efficiency, drives consistency across regions, and enables existing team members to focus on higher-value strategic activities.

jobs.title: Pricing Strategy Lead - Vice President / Senior Vice President
jobs.description:
About the Role

iCapital is seeking a Vice President or Senior Vice President to lead Pricing Strategy and support one of iCapital's most important strategic functions. This role sits at the center of key business decisions, partnering closely with senior executive leadership to develop pricing strategies that drive growth, profitability, and long-term enterprise value. This role will help shape pricing frameworks, evaluate client and product opportunities, assess competitive dynamics, and develop data-driven recommendations that balance commercial objectives with sustainable economics. Operating at the intersection of strategy, finance, analytics, and business development, this role offers significant executive visibility and the opportunity to influence firm-wide commercial strategy across products, channels, and geographies.

Responsibilities

- Lead the firm's Pricing Committee, including agenda development, analysis, governance, recommendations, and follow-up actions.

- Partner directly with executive leadership on strategic pricing decisions, commercial opportunities, and business growth initiatives.

- Work with the Business Development, Relationship Management, Distribution, and Product teams to structure and price new business opportunities and strategic client engagements.

- Build and lead a pricing strategy team responsible for reviewing client-specific requests, conducting analyses, and supporting commercial decision-making.

- Design and enhance pricing frameworks that support product positioning, value-based pricing, and long-term competitive differentiation.

- Own and maintain the Global Standard Pricing Compendium, ensuring pricing frameworks remain current, scalable, and consistently applied.

- Build and maintain pricing precedents, historical decisions, and supporting documentation to improve consistency and decision quality.

- Draft, implement, and maintain pricing policies, governance standards, and control procedures.

- Develop pricing analyses, dashboards, and reporting on pricing trends, fee realization, take rates, margin performance, and business mix evolution.

- Conduct market, competitor, and industry research to evaluate pricing trends, fee compression risks, and emerging commercial strategies.

- Partner closely with Strategic Finance teams to model revenue opportunities, cost structures, profitability, and return on investment for pricing decisions.

- Develop best-in-class disclosures and client-facing language describing iCapital's pricing methodologies, value proposition, and commercial arrangements.

Qualifications

- 9 - 15 years of experience in pricing strategy, management consulting, strategic finance, investment banking, private equity, corporate strategy, or other analytical and commercial leadership roles

- Experience developing pricing strategies, commercial frameworks, revenue optimization initiatives, or profitability analyses within financial services, fintech, asset management, or related industries

- Exceptional analytical capabilities, including financial modeling, business case development, pricing analytics, and quantitative decision support.

- Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and effectively communicate complex analyses to C-suite audiences and synthesizing large amounts of data into actionable recommendations and executive-ready presentations

- Strong commercial judgment with the ability to balance revenue growth, profitability, client needs, and competitive positioning

- Experience working cross-functionally with finance, sales, product, operations, legal, and executive leadership teams

- Track record of building processes, governance frameworks, and scalable operating models in evolving organizations

- Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to develop executive materials, committee presentations, policies, and client-facing content

- Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives simultaneously

- Previous experience leading teams and developing talent is preferred

- Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; experience with pricing analytics, business intelligence, and financial planning tools are a plus

Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $160,000 to $240,000.  iCapital offers a compensation package which includes salary, equity for all full-time employees, and an annual performance bonus. Employees also receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes an employer matched retirement plan, generously subsidized healthcare with 100% employer paid dental, vision, telemedicine, and virtual mental health counseling, parental leave, and unlimited paid time off (PTO).

We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office Monday-Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Friday.

For additional information on iCapital, please visit  https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us   Twitter: @icapitalnetwork | LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/icapital-network-inc | Awards Disclaimer: https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us/recognition/

jobs.title: Security Operations Manager - Assistant Vice President
jobs.description:
About the Role

iCapital is looking to hire a SOC Manager to join its Global Information Security team, based in Lisbon, Portugal. This role manages the day-to-day operations of the Security Operations Center (SOC) and leads the team of analysts who monitor, triage, and respond to security alerts. The SOC Manager provides situational awareness through detecting, containing, and resolving cyber security threats using a comprehensive set of technologies including IDS, IPS, DLP, SIEM, SOAR, AWS, SaaS Security, and firewall technologies.

This is a people-management role focused on keeping the SOC running smoothly – coverage, runbooks, triage, and escalation – while developing the analyst team. The SOC Manager works closely with the Cyber Case Manager to ensure incidents flow into case management and are tracked through to closure, and partners with Threat Detection Engineering, Cloud Security, Incident Response, and other Information Security teams to strengthen the firm’s overall cyber resiliency. Based in Lisbon, the role helps provide security operations coverage across global time zones. This role reports to the Security Operations Leader.

Responsibilities

- Manage the day-to-day operations of the Security Operations Center, ensuring monitoring, alerting, triage, and incident response run effectively across the operating day.

- Lead, mentor, and develop a team of SOC analysts – including scheduling, shift and on-call coverage, performance management, hiring, and onboarding.

- Establish and maintain runbooks, playbooks, incident-handling procedures, and daily, weekly, and monthly security checklists.

- Operate, tune, and manage the SIEM and SOAR platforms; maintain alerts and dashboards that surface key security events and provide security assurance.

- Triage and escalate incidents quickly and effectively, setting priorities for the SOC team and coordinating response with other teams across the firm.

- Partner closely with the Cyber Case Manager to ensure incidents flow into case management and are tracked to closure, and to keep the team aligned to case-driven priorities.

- Work alongside Threat Detection Engineering, Cloud Security, Incident Response, and other Information Security teams to improve the firm’s security posture.

- Measure and report on the state of the firm’s cyber security defenses, including operational metrics and regular reporting to leadership.

- Serve as an escalation point for high-severity incidents, including outside standard business hours as needed.

- Drive the evaluation, selection, and configuration of key security tools to enhance Cyber Security Operations.

Qualifications

- 5-8 years of experience in security operations, including 1-3 years leading or managing a SOC or security operations team.

- Demonstrated people-management experience – leading, mentoring, scheduling, and developing analysts.

- Hands-on experience with the setup and management of a SIEM, preferably Splunk.

- Experience with SOAR and a strong understanding of the incident-response lifecycle and frameworks such as NIST and MITRE ATT&CK.

- Knowledge of Linux, Windows, and macOS operating systems.

- Experience with cloud infrastructure, AWS preferred.

- Strong coordination and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to liaise across teams and report to leadership.

- Professional fluency in English to support a global team.

- Attentive, organized, and detail-oriented, with solid problem-solving and analytical skills.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills..

We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office four days, with the flexibility to work remotely one day (Friday).

Benefits

iCapital offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes a total compensation program consisting of competitive salary, annual performance bonus, and equity for all full-time employees; healthcare with 100% employer-paid health and dental insurance; and generous paid time off (PTO).

jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
About the Role

iCapital is seeking a Technology Program Manager to partner closely with Engineering and Technology leadership teams to deliver complex, high-impact initiatives across the firm’s most critical technology priorities. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution, bringing best-in-class program management practices to large-scale, cross-functional initiatives. The team operates in an internal consulting capacity, driving clarity, alignment, and disciplined execution across multi-team programs. This individual will engage across a diverse portfolio including greenfield software development, enterprise vendor implementations, cloud and infrastructure initiatives, data and analytics and machine learning efforts, and broader technology innovation programs.

As iCapital continues to scale, the company is increasingly leveraging AI-enabled tools and automation to enhance engineering productivity and program transparency. This role requires comfort operating in an AI-augmented environment, identifying opportunities to use emerging technologies to improve planning, reporting, decision-making, and cross-team coordination. This is a leadership and execution role focused on orchestration, visibility, and delivery excellence; it does not involve hands-on coding or testing.

Responsibilities

- Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, cross-functional technology programs spanning multiple engineering teams.

- Partner with the Engineering teams to define scope, roadmap, milestones, and measurable outcomes.

- Establish clear governance, reporting, and risk management practices to ensure transparency and accountability.

- Communicate program status, risks, dependencies, and mitigation strategies to senior stakeholders.

- Collaborate with Technology leadership to shape forward-looking strategy and execution frameworks.

- Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance delivery effectiveness across the broader Technology teams.
